title: Standard Vehicle JSON (SVJ)
description: Schema for SVJ v0.94 — universal vehicle dynamics exchange format.

^x_.description: Simulator-specific extension. Parsers MUST ignore unrecognized x_ keys.

source_format.description: Original file format if this SVJ was converted (e.g. 'CarSim', 'Assetto Corsa'). Null for native SVJ.

data_origin.description: Provenance of the vehicle data in this file.

type.description: Primary source of data. manufacturer = OEM spec sheets / press data. simulation = extracted from a game or sim (see detail). measured = physical test (K&C rig, dyno, laser scan). calculated = engineering estimates or derived values. mixed = combination of sources. unknown = provenance not recorded.

detail.description: Free-text elaboration, e.g. game title, test facility, calculation method.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the dataset. high = factory or measured data dominates. medium = mix of confirmed and estimated. low = mostly estimated or unverified.

alignment_convention.description: Alignment sign convention. relative_to_centerline: negative camber = top leans inward on BOTH sides.

mass_bodies.description: Sprung mass decomposition into individually positioned rigid bodies.

lock_to_lock_turns.description: Total steering wheel rotation in turns

mass.description: Clutch assembly mass (pressure plate + disc + release bearing) (kg)

sets.description: Named tire sets keyed by identifier.

vec3.description: 3D coordinate [x, y, z] in meters, SAE J670.

curve2d.description: Array of [x, y] data points, sorted by x.

bushings.description: Bushing at each inboard point. bushings[i] corresponds to inboard_points[i].

sprung_fraction.description: Fraction of link mass that counts as sprung (0.0-1.0). Remainder is unsprung.

set_ref.description: Reference to a tire set id in tires.sets. Authoritative source for tire dimensions.

mass.description: Damper mass (kg). Body = sprung, rod+piston ≈ unsprung.
ARB bar mass for this axle (kg). Shared between both corners — enter full bar mass, not half.

mass_body.description: A single rigid body contributing to the sprung mass.

lateral.description: Pacejka lateral (Fy) coefficients: pCy1, pDy1-3, pEy1-5, pKy1-7, pHy1-3, pVy1-4, pPy1-5.

longitudinal.description: Pacejka longitudinal (Fx) coefficients: pCx1, pDx1-3, pEx1-4, pKx1-3, pHx1-2, pVx1-2, pPx1-4.

aligning.description: Self-aligning torque (Mz) coefficients: qBz1-10, qCz1, qDz1-11, qEz1-5, qHz1-4.

combined.description: Combined slip weighting: rBx1-3, rCx1, rHx1, rBy1-4, rCy1, rHy1, rVy1-6.

rotational_inertia.description: Disc spin inertia about wheel axis (kg·m²). Added to wheel rotational_inertia for total spinning mass.
